verdicts.item: - Witness: the State 2 security-review gate of the authoring sequence runs this lint [witness: workbench:state2_rules_decisions].
statements: Every category resolves to an accepted decision or an open question.
quotes: f"Security category {category!r} has no explicit outcome.",
f"Security category {category!r} must reference an indexed accepted decision in States 0–2.",
open_questions = [entry for entry in resolved if entry["kind"] == "open_question"]
f"UNRESOLVED security category {category!r} must reference an indexed open question.",
verdicts.why: The check requires every enumerated security category to have an explicit outcome, and validates that APPLICABLE categories reference an indexed decision while UNRESOLVED categories reference an indexed open question. However, NOT_APPLICABLE categories require only a rationale and need not resolve to either an accepted decision or an open question, so the stated invariant is not fully asserted.
